name: Malav Rana
headline: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance, and accessible web applications. Skilled in React, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks. Experienced in integrating REST and GraphQL APIs, optimizing complex UI workflows, implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and accessibility compliance. Collaborative team player focused on delivering user-friendly, maintainable software solutions across multiple projects.

Integrated REST and GraphQL with caching and state management to improve responsiveness.
Applied code splitting, lazy loading, and WCAG-aligned, cross-device UX.
Delivered enterprise UIs with React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, and Styled Components.
Integrated REST and GraphQL with automated testing (Jest, RTL, Playwright).

Built interactive pharmacy workflows with React, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Integrated secure REST APIs with JWT/OAuth and strong validation.
Improved load times with modular components and optimized rendering.
Shipped responsive web apps with React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Integrated RESTful APIs for dynamic content and consistent workflows.
Worked in Agile/SCRUM with code reviews and documentation.
